pages.title: Judy Hopps Waving in an Off-Shoulder Top Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps waving with a cheerful smile, wearing a striped off-shoulder top and shorts, surrounded by floating hearts and sparkles.

pages.title: Judy Hopps Holding a Large Feather Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Judy Hopps looking up at a large feather she holds in one paw, with upright ears, a police uniform, and a utility belt.

pages.title: Judy Hopps in a Flowing Ruffled Gown Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps posing in an elegant layered gown with flowing ruffles, a flower-decorated hair bun, wide eyes, and a rose on her shoulder.

pages.title: Relaxing Judy Hopps Pajamas Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Judy Hopps reclining against a couch in carrot-patterned pajamas, holding a coffee mug labeled BYE and a TV remote. Nearby sits a container of instant noodles against floral pillows. Thick outlines make this sheet great for shading with alcohol markers or colored pencils.

pages.title: Free Printable Zootopia Judy Hopps at Farmers Market Coloring Page for Kids
pages.description: This printable page is ready with a scene featuring zootopia judy hopps at farmers market. Works well for party activities, family time, or after school fun. Encourages creative exploration through fun coloring sessions. Clean outlines keep the page clear and enjoyable to finish.
